units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 5. Prevention and resolution of a conflict of interest to which a person specified in part 1 of Article 10 of this Federal Law is a party shall be effected by the disqualification or voluntary recusal of that person in the cases and according to the procedure provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 6. Failure by a person specified in part 1 of Article 10 of this Federal Law who is a party to a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve the conflict of interest constitutes an offense entailing that person’s dismissal in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 7. If a person specified in part 1 of Article 10 of this Federal Law owns securities (participation interests or shares in the charter (pooled) capitals of organizations), that person shall, to prevent a conflict of interest, transfer the securities (participation interests or shares in the charter (pooled) capitals of organizations) belonging to that person into trust management in accordance with civil legislation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: Article 11.1. Duties of Employees of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, Employees Holding Positions in State Corporations (Companies), Public-Law Companies, State Extrabudgetary Funds of the Russian Federation and Other Organizations Established by the Russian Federation under Federal Laws, Employees Holding Certain Positions under Employment Contracts in Organizations Established to Carry Out Tasks Assigned to Federal State Bodies, and Persons Holding the Positions of Financial Ombudsman or Head of the Service Supporting the Activities of the Financial Ombudsman
units.label: Part 7 Art. 11 · “Article 11.1. Duties of Employees of the Central Bank of the…”

units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: Employees of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, employees holding positions in state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation and other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws, employees holding certain positions under employment contracts in organizations established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, and persons holding the positions of Financial Ombudsman or head of the service supporting the activities of the Financial Ombudsman shall, in accordance with Articles 9–11 of this Federal Law, report approaches made to them by any persons for the purpose of inducing them to commit corruption offenses, report the emergence, in the performance of official duties, of a personal interest that leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, and take measures to preclude any possibility of a conflict of interest arising, according to the procedure determined by regulatory acts of federal state bodies, the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation and other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 11 · “Employees of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation,…”

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.label: Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 1. A citizen who previously held a state or municipal service position included in a list established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation may, during the two years following dismissal from state or municipal service, hold positions in an organization under an employment contract and/or perform work in that organization (provide services to that organization) under a civil-law contract (civil-law contracts) worth more than one hundred thousand rubles in a month, if certain functions of state or municipal (administrative) management of that organization formed part of the state or municipal servant’s official (service) duties, with the consent of the relevant commission on compliance with requirements for the official conduct of state or municipal servants and the resolution of conflicts of interest.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 1.1. The commission shall, according to the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, consider a citizen’s written application for consent to hold a position in an organization under an employment contract and/or to perform work in that organization (provide services to that organization) under a civil-law contract, if certain functions of state or municipal (administrative) management of that organization formed part of the citizen’s official (service) duties, and shall inform the citizen of the decision taken.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 2. A citizen who previously held state or municipal service positions whose list is established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation shall, during the two years following dismissal from state or municipal service, when concluding employment contracts or civil-law contracts for the performance of work (provision of services) specified in part 1 of this Article, inform the employer of the last place of that citizen’s service.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 3. Failure by a citizen who previously held state or municipal service positions whose list is established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation to comply, after dismissal from state or municipal service, with the requirement provided for in part 2 of this Article entails termination of the employment contract or civil-law contract for the performance of work (provision of services) specified in part 1 of this Article concluded with that citizen.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 4. When concluding an employment contract or a civil-law contract for the performance of work (provision of services) specified in part 1 of this Article with a citizen who previously held state or municipal service positions whose list is established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, within two years following that citizen’s dismissal from state or municipal service, the employer shall, within ten days, notify the employer’s representative (employer) of the state or municipal servant at the last place of service of the conclusion of that contract, according to the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 5. An employer’s failure to perform the duty established by part 4 of this Article constitutes an offense and entails liability in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 6. Verification of compliance by the citizen specified in part 1 of this Article with the prohibition on holding a position in an organization under an employment contract and/or performing work in that organization (providing services to that organization) under a civil-law contract (civil-law contracts), in cases provided for by federal laws, if certain functions of state management of that organization formed part of the civil or municipal servant’s official (service) duties, and verification of the employer’s compliance with the conditions for concluding an employment contract or the conditions for concluding a civil-law contract with such a citizen, shall be carried out according to the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 7. Where a citizen subject to restrictions under this Article is appointed, by decision of the President of the Russian Federation, to an organization specified in part 1 of this Article, the following shall not be required:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 1) the consent of the relevant commission on compliance with requirements for the official conduct of state or municipal servants and the resolution of conflicts of interest;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Restrictions Imposed on a Citizen Who Previously Held a State or Municipal Service Position When Concluding an Employment or Civil-Law Contract
units.text: 2) the reporting of information provided for in parts 2 and 4 of this Article.
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.label: Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 1. Persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation or state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may not hold other state offices of the Russian Federation or state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, unless otherwise established by federal constitutional laws or federal laws. They may not hold municipal offices or state or municipal service positions either.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 2. Persons holding municipal offices may not hold state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, other municipal offices, or state or municipal service positions, unless otherwise established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3. Persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation, and persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal offices and exercising their powers on a full-time basis, unless otherwise established by federal constitutional laws or federal laws, may not:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 1) hold other positions in state authorities or local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 2) engage in entrepreneurial activity personally or through authorized representatives;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3) engage in other paid activities, except teaching, scientific and other creative activities. Teaching, scientific and other creative activities may not be financed exclusively by funds of foreign states, international or foreign organizations, foreign citizens or stateless persons, unless otherwise provided for by international treaties of the Russian Federation, the legislation of the Russian Federation or reciprocal arrangements between federal state authorities and state bodies of foreign states or international or foreign organizations;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4) act as attorneys-in-fact or other representatives in third-party matters before state authorities or local self-government bodies, unless otherwise provided for by federal laws;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 5) use information or material, technical, financial or information support resources intended solely for official activities for non-official purposes;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 6) receive fees for publications or speaking engagements in the capacity of a person holding a state office of the Russian Federation, a state office of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, the office of head of a municipality or a municipal office held on a full-time basis;
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 7) receive, in connection with the performance of service (official) duties, rewards (loans, monetary or other remuneration, services, payment for entertainment, recreation or transportation expenses) and gifts that are not provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, from individuals or legal entities. Gifts received in connection with protocol events, official business trips or other official events shall be recognized as the property of the Russian Federation, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a municipality, respectively, and shall be transferred to the relevant state or municipal body against a transfer record. A person who held a state office of the Russian Federation, a state office of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, the office of head of a municipality or a municipal office held on a full-time basis and who surrendered a gift received in connection with a protocol event, an official business trip or another official event may purchase it according to the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 8) accept, contrary to the established procedure, honorary or special titles, awards or other distinctions (except scientific and sporting ones) of foreign states, international organizations, political parties, other public associations or other organizations;
units.label: Point 8 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 9) travel on official business trips outside the Russian Federation at the expense of individuals or legal entities, except for official business trips undertaken in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation under arrangements between state bodies of the Russian Federation, state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal bodies and state or municipal bodies of foreign states or international or foreign organizations;
units.label: Point 9 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 10) serve on management bodies, boards of trustees or supervisory boards, or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations or their structural subdivisions operating in the territory of the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided for by international treaties of the Russian Federation, the legislation of the Russian Federation or reciprocal arrangements between federal state authorities and state bodies of foreign states or international or foreign organizations;
units.label: Point 10 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 11) disclose, or use for purposes unrelated to the performance of official duties, information classified under federal law as restricted-access information that became known to them in connection with the performance of official duties.
units.label: Point 11 Part 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3.1. Persons holding the offices of heads of municipalities and exercising their powers on a non-full-time basis may not engage in the activities provided for in points 4–11 of part 3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3.2. Persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation, unless otherwise established by federal constitutional laws or federal laws, may not participate in the management of a commercial or nonprofit organization, except in the following cases:
units.label: Part 3.2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 1) unpaid participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, or participation in the congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real property owners;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3.2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 2) unpaid participation in the management of a nonprofit organization (other than participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, or participation in the congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real property owners), with prior notification to the President of the Russian Federation according to the procedure established by the President of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3.2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3) unpaid participation in the activities of an organization’s collegial body on the basis of an act of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3.2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4) unpaid representation of the interests of the Russian Federation in the management bodies and audit commission of an organization whose founder (shareholder, participant) is the Russian Federation, in accordance with regulatory legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation that determine the procedure for exercising the powers of an organization’s founder on behalf of the Russian Federation or the procedure for managing federally owned shares (participation interests in charter capital);
units.label: Point 4 Part 3.2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 5) other cases provided for by international treaties or federal laws.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3.2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3.3. Deputies of the legislative bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation who exercise their powers on a professional full-time basis, unless otherwise established by federal laws, may not participate in the management of a commercial or nonprofit organization, except in the following cases:
units.label: Part 3.3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 1) unpaid participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, or participation in the congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real property owners;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3.3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 2) unpaid participation in the management of a nonprofit organization (other than participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, or participation in the congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real property owners), with prior notification to the legislative body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3.3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3) unpaid representation of the interests of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the management bodies and audit commission of an organization whose founder (shareholder, participant) is that constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in accordance with regulatory legal acts of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation that determine the procedure for exercising the powers of an organization’s founder on behalf of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the procedure for managing shares (participation interests in charter capital) owned by the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3.3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4) other cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3.3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3.3-1. Persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and exercising their powers on a non-full-time basis may not engage in the activities provided for in points 1 and 4–11 of part 3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3.3-1 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3.4. Persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (except deputies of the legislative bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation) and exercising their powers on a full-time basis, unless otherwise established by federal laws, may not participate in the management of a commercial or nonprofit organization, except in the following cases:
units.label: Part 3.4 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 1) unpaid participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, or participation in the congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real property owners;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3.4 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 2) unpaid participation in the management of a nonprofit organization (other than participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, or participation in the congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real property owners), with prior notification to the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation according to the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3.4 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3) unpaid membership of a collegial body of a commercial or nonprofit organization on the basis of an act of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3.4 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4) unpaid representation of the interests of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the management bodies and audit commission of an organization whose founder (shareholder, participant) is that constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in accordance with regulatory legal acts of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation that determine the procedure for exercising the powers of an organization’s founder on behalf of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the procedure for managing shares (participation interests in charter capital) owned by the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3.4 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 5) other cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3.4 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3.5. Persons holding municipal offices and exercising their powers on a full-time basis, unless otherwise established by federal laws, may not participate in the management of a commercial or nonprofit organization, except in the following cases:
units.label: Part 3.5 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 1) unpaid participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participation in the congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real property owners;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3.5 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 2) unpaid participation in the management of a nonprofit organization (other than participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participation in the congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real property owners), with prior notification to the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation according to the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3.5 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 3) unpaid representation of the interests of a municipality in the council of municipalities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in other associations of municipalities and in their management bodies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3.5 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4) unpaid representation of the interests of a municipality in the management bodies and audit commission of an organization whose founder (shareholder, participant) is the municipality, in accordance with municipal legal acts that determine the procedure for exercising the powers of an organization’s founder on behalf of the municipality or the procedure for managing municipally owned shares (interests in charter capital);
units.label: Point 4 Part 3.5 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 5) other cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3.5 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4. Unless otherwise established by federal laws, citizens seeking to hold state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal offices, and persons holding those offices, shall submit information on their income, property and property-related obligations and on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouses and minor children when vested with the powers of office (appointed or elected to office). If a person cannot submit information on their income, property and property-related obligations and on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouse and minor children when vested with the powers of an office to which appointment is made by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation or upon a nomination by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, that information shall be submitted within four months of the date of appointment. A person holding a state office of the Russian Federation, a state office of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a municipal office shall submit the information specified in this part if grounds arise for that person to submit information on expenditure under Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 “On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons and Their Income”, no later than 30 April of the year following the year in which those grounds arose. The information specified in this part shall be submitted according to the procedure established by this Federal Law, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4.1. Persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal offices shall, according to the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, report the emergence, in the performance of official duties, of a personal interest that leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, and shall take measures to prevent or resolve that conflict.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4.1-1. Persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall notify prosecution bodies or other state bodies of all instances in which any persons approach them for the purpose of inducing them to commit corruption offenses, no later than five days from the date of the relevant approach, according to the procedure established by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided for by federal laws. Notification of approaches intended to induce the commission of corruption offenses, except where the relevant facts have been or are being verified by prosecution bodies or other state bodies, is an official duty of persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation. Persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation who have notified prosecution bodies or other state bodies of approaches intended to induce them to commit a corruption offense, or of corruption offenses committed by other persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or by state or municipal servants, shall be under state protection in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4.1-1 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4.1-2. A deputy of the legislative body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall submit information on their income, property and property-related obligations and on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouse and minor children according to the procedure established by this Federal Law and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, if grounds arise for the deputy to submit information on expenditure under Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 “On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons and Their Income”. That information on income, property and property-related obligations shall be submitted no later than 30 April of the year following the year in which those grounds arose.
units.label: Part 4.1-2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4.2. Unless otherwise established by federal law, citizens seeking to hold a municipal office and persons holding municipal offices shall submit information on their income, property and property-related obligations and on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouses and minor children to the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation according to the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. A person holding the municipal office of deputy of the representative body of a municipality shall submit the information provided for in this part if grounds arise for that person to submit information on expenditure under Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 “On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons and Their Income”. That information on income, property and property-related obligations shall be submitted no later than 30 April of the year following the year in which those grounds arose. Access to information concerning the disclosures provided for in this part submitted by persons holding municipal offices as deputies of a municipality’s representative body, and to information concerning such persons’ submission of knowingly inaccurate or incomplete disclosures, shall be ensured in accordance with federal laws and Presidential decrees of the Russian Federation. Aggregate information on the performance (improper performance) by persons holding municipal offices as deputies of a municipality’s representative body of the duty established by this part shall be published on the official websites of local self-government bodies (provided that such information contains neither personal data enabling identification of the person concerned nor data enabling individual identification of property belonging to that person), according to the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4.2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4.3. Repealed with effect from 1 January 2026. — Federal Law No. 505-ФЗ of 28.12.2025.
units.label: Part 4.3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4.4. The accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted under part 4.2 of this Article shall be verified by decision of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation according to the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4.4 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Restrictions and Duties Imposed on Persons Holding State Offices of the Russian Federation, State Offices of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, and Municipal Offices
units.text: 4.5. Where a verification conducted under part 4.4 of this Article reveals that a person holding a municipal office has failed to comply with restrictions or prohibitions or to perform duties established by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 “On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons and Their Income”, or Federal Law No. 79-ФЗ of 7 May 2013 “On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments”, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall apply to the local self-government body authorized to take the relevant decision, or to a court, for early termination of the powers of the person holding a municipal office or for another disciplinary penalty to be imposed on that person.
units.label: Part 4.5 Art. 12.1
